skill.name: market-research-reports
skill.description: Create long-form market research reports with structured research guidance, strategic frameworks, professional LaTeX formatting, and visual generation workflows.
skill.summary: Create consulting-style market research reports with sourced analysis, visuals, and LaTeX formatting.

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from LaTeX paths, Markdown code formatting, and market research vocabulary. The only confirmed issue is the batch visual script executing local generator scripts through subprocess.run; no prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Batch visual generation runs external local scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Document this behavior clearly, keep shell=False, validate tool paths, and restrict output directories to the active report workspace.

remediation.issue: Report templates use parent-directory LaTeX paths for figures and references.
remediation.suggestion: Explain the expected project layout or switch to paths that avoid parent traversal syntax where possible.

remediation.issue: Markdown command examples may be mistaken for executable shell behavior.
remediation.suggestion: Label command blocks as examples and remind users to review paths and tool availability before running them.

content.value_statement: Market teams need structured reports with sourced data, visuals, and strategic frameworks. This skill guides research, analysis, visualization, and LaTeX report assembly.
actual_capabilities: Defines a 50 page market research report structure with chapters, appendices, and quality checks.
Guides research collection using market size, competitor, trend, regulatory, and source requirements.
Applies frameworks including TAM, SAM, SOM, Porters Five Forces, PESTLE, SWOT, and BCG Matrix.
Provides LaTeX templates, style guidance, boxes, figures, tables, and bibliography structure.
Includes a Python script to batch request core and extended report visuals from local visual tools.
Supplies prompts and checklists for reviewing completeness, citations, visuals, and PDF output.
limitations: The skill does not guarantee that market data is current or accurate without source verification.
Visual generation depends on separate local skills and image generation tools being available.
PDF compilation requires a working LaTeX environment and compatible fonts or packages.
The output is research support, not financial, legal, or investment advice.

use_cases.title: Build an investment market scan
use_cases.description: Create a structured market report with sizing, growth drivers, risks, and an investment thesis.

use_cases.title: Prepare a market entry brief
use_cases.description: Analyze customers, competitors, regulations, and implementation options before entering a new market.

use_cases.title: Standardize analyst deliverables
use_cases.description: Use repeatable templates, frameworks, visuals, and review criteria for client-ready research reports.

prompt_templates.title: Start a report outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a market research report outline for [market]. Include scope, target geography, key questions, required visuals, and data sources.

prompt_templates.title: Research market size
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the [market] market size for [region]. Estimate TAM, SAM, SOM, CAGR, key assumptions, and source requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze competition
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a competitive landscape for [market]. Include top competitors, market shares, Porters Five Forces, positioning, barriers, and required visuals.

prompt_templates.title: Produce full report package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full market research report for [market] in [region]. Generate the research plan, analysis frameworks, visual plan, LaTeX structure, review checklist, and final recommendations.

output_examples.input: Analyze the electric vehicle charging market in North America.
output: Executive summary with market size, growth rate, and key recommendations.
Chapters for market overview, competitive landscape, customer segments, regulation, risks, and roadmap.
Visual plan covering growth trajectory, TAM/SAM/SOM, Five Forces, risk heatmap, and implementation timeline.

output_examples.input: Create a market entry report for AI diagnostics in Europe.
output: Market definition, regulatory considerations, customer segments, and competitive positioning.
Strategic options with opportunity sizing, risks, mitigation plans, and implementation phases.
Source checklist for market reports, government data, company filings, and clinical adoption studies.

output_examples.input: Review whether my market report is complete.
output: Completeness review against chapter, visual, citation, and page-count requirements.
Gap list for missing sources, weak assumptions, incomplete frameworks, and unresolved placeholders.
Recommended next edits before PDF compilation and stakeholder review.

best_practices: Define market scope, geography, segment boundaries, and time horizon before collecting data.
Verify every statistic with named sources and record assumptions for all projections.
Generate visuals early, then update captions and citations after the written analysis is complete.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated market numbers as facts without source checks.
Do not fill a long report with generic framework text that lacks market-specific evidence.
Do not compile or share the PDF while placeholders, missing citations, or broken figures remain.

faq.question: What kind of reports does this skill create?
faq.answer: It supports long-form market research reports with market sizing, trends, competitors, risks, recommendations, visuals, and LaTeX formatting.

faq.question: Does it gather live market data automatically?
faq.answer: It provides research prompts and workflows. The user must verify sources and confirm that data is current.

faq.question: Can it make charts and diagrams?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompts and a batch script that call separate visual generation skills when they are installed.

faq.question: Does it create a finished PDF?
faq.answer: It provides LaTeX templates and compilation steps. A working LaTeX setup is required to create the PDF.

faq.question: Who is the skill best for?
faq.answer: It is best for analysts, strategy teams, founders, and consultants who need repeatable market research deliverables.

faq.question: Should users rely on the report for investment decisions?
faq.answer: No. The report can support analysis, but financial, legal, and investment decisions need professional review.
